item.description: Learn how to get paid as quickly as possible.

item.title: Can I dispute a review?
item.description: Find out what to do if you'd like to respond to a review you've received.

item.title: Navigating Delivery as a Creator
item.description: 90 Seconds has introduced a new Delivery app designed to improve the workflow for Creators and Brands. This update streamlines the entire job completion process, from accepting gigs to submitting final deliverables. With clear task-based workflows, real-time tracking, and an improved approval system, creators can now manage their jobs more efficiently while ensuring high-quality content delivery.

item.title: Content App Guide for Creators
item.description: The new Content App is a great way for you to upload and share files with the Brands and concierge team throughout a project.

item.title: Managing your Workflows
item.description: The new Delivery app makes it easy to manage your projects using workflows. Each workflow includes a unique set of tasks and instructions for Creators.

item.title: Brand Dashboard Overview
item.description: This guide is here to help you understand your brand’s dashboard and show you how to navigate its key features. From creating your first order to managing your team, we’ll walk you through everything you need to get up and running smoothly.

item.title: Creating a New Order
item.description: Our new Order page lets you create and customize your project based on your specific needs — from choosing services and setting dates to uploading briefs and assets. Prefer a tailored approach? Our Concierge Team is here to help every step of the way.

item.title: Navigating Delivery and communicating with Creators
item.description: 90 Seconds has introduced a new Delivery app designed to enhance the workflow for Brands and Creators. With clear task-based workflows, real-time tracking, and an improved approval system, Brands can now monitor project progress more efficiently, ensure smoother collaboration with Creators, and receive high-quality content with greater ease. This guide walks you through the process step-by-step.

item.title: Communicating with 90 Seconds’ Concierge
item.description: Our Concierge team is here to support your order every step of the way. You can easily message a Concierge team member directly through the platform.
